profile.headline: Focused on reliability and scalability
profile.summary:
Expert software engineer and leader with 10+ years of experience developing and building developer platforms, event driven systems, and developer tools. Broad experience in Agile and Lean methodologies, building highly reliable systems in fast paced cross-functional collaboration. Continuously improving the systems I work on, the teams I work with and my own expertise. Proven track record of delivering valuable, reliable software with quality and speed. 

I move fast without breaking things.

positions.title: Sr. Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved throughput of critical EDI systems by more than 10x at Zoro.com
Improved EDI system p99 memory usage by 75% and p50 latency by 80%
Mentored team mates in cloud architecture and event sourcing
positions.insights: Skills: Site Reliability Engineering · Software Architecture · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · python · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Co-Founder, Principle Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Built and operated a securities platform in Next.js and Go handling $1M+ in investments
Implemented Lean product and Agile engineering practices to enable quality and speed
Built a high-performing and efficient product engineering team

projects.title: Volition
projects.description: Volition is an open-source, Rust-specialized AI coding assistant that empowers developers to interact with their codebase through natural language. Built with a focus on flexibility and extensibility, Volition supports multiple AI providers and interaction strategies.
